装备者的附着物伤害提升<lv>{1}</>，释放「极轨终结」时，附着物伤害提升效果变为<lv>{2}</>，持续<lv>{3}</>秒，该效果不可叠加。

tested_hypotheses: Anima DMG is modeled as Nature-damage packets, following the frozen The Wrong Gate precedent where the native 'Anima DMG' description binds to damage_bonus:ECharacterElementType::CHARACTER_ELEMENT_TYPE_NATURE.

Attachment DMG is recognized by the content-owned ntesim.damage.attachment packet semantic tag; the tag is not asserted to be the native GameplayTag name because the frozen tables do not expose that binding. No modeled character currently emits it, so both Attachment bonuses are structurally present but inert in the current roster.

Both static bonuses and the timed override sum into the additive damage-bonus zone (COMBAT_FORMULA_CONTRACT zone table: General + matching damage type bonuses sum together into M_bonus); they never multiply.
A packet that is both Nature and Attachment-tagged receives both the Anima and the Attachment bonus additively.

Successful wearer Ultimate admission applies the timed buff at admission time via the cast-time buff path (Call of the Twisted City precedent); a recast resets the same PerSource instance (RefreshPolicy::Reset, max one stack), so the effect does not stack.
The timed buff replaces rather than adds to the static Attachment bonus while live: delivery-time buff sampling reads the override value and the static value is skipped for Attachment packets.
The buff is wearer-only (BuffRecipient::SelfActor) and survives switching until world-time expiry; expiry is sampled at hit delivery by the BuffManager.
Cast admission order and BuffManager expiry sampling at hit delivery are tested timing hypotheses; native animation timing remains unresolved.
Frozen package evidence does not establish Global release availability.
